description:
[Trading Data API] Multi-asset momentum verdict (bias, confidence, thesis, entry/invalidation/targets, signal readings) from the oracle.py pipeline, run on a separate Python service — Multi-asset momentum verdict (bias, confidence, thesis, entry/invalidation/targets, signal readings) from the oracle.py pipeline, run on a separate Python service. Scoped to 10 assets.

**Example:** `/v1/momentum-score?symbol=BTC&timeframe=1h`

symbol.description: Required. One of: BTC, ETH, SOL, SUI, NVDA, IBIT, COIN, QQQ, TQQQ, DIA.

name: momentum_score
